get.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-05

Returns account information, role, and whether a password is configured.

patch.description:
**Access:** User

Updates the signed-in user name or avatar URL.

delete.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-07

Deletes the account and all data, including resume files in storage. This supports Apple's App Store account-deletion requirement.

patch.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-09

Changes or sets the password for the signed-in user.

**Rules:** `currentPassword` is required only when the account already has a password.

**Error note:** The SDD does not define a distinct wrong-current-password code; `VALIDATION_ERROR` is used for that case.

get.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-08

Returns the social sign-in providers connected to the signed-in account.

**Rules:** This response is not paginated because the number of identities is small.

delete.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-08

Unlinks a social sign-in provider from the signed-in account.

**Rules:** The operation is blocked if it would leave the user with no identity and no password.

post.description:
**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-01

Creates an account and sends a verification email.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-01

Confirms an email address using a single-use token.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-01a

Sends a new verification email and always returns success without revealing whether the email exists.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-05

Returns access and refresh tokens with the authenticated user.

**Access:** Public

Rotates the refresh token. Reuse of an old token revokes the whole token family.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-06

Revokes the supplied refresh token so logout works after the access token expires.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-04

Sends a reset email and always returns success without revealing whether the email exists.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-04

Sets a new password and revokes all refresh tokens for the user.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUTH-03

Verifies the Google ID token and returns tokens with the user account. The audience must match one of our iOS, Android, or web client IDs. A new identity links to an existing account only when Google confirms the email is verified.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUTH-03

Verifies the Apple identity token and returns tokens with the user account. Send `fullName` only on the first sign-in; Apple provides it once. A new identity links to an existing account only when Apple confirms the email is verified.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUTH-03

Validates the Facebook access token and returns tokens with the user account. The provider email may be missing. A new identity links to an existing account only when Facebook confirms the email is verified.

**Access:** Public
**Requirements:** FR-AUTH-02, FR-AUTH-03

Exchanges the browser authorization code with LinkedIn and returns tokens with the user account. A new identity links to an existing account only when LinkedIn confirms the email is verified.

get.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-PROF-01, FR-PROF-02

Returns the signed-in user's target role, industry, experience level, and location, including category names for display.

put.description:
**Access:** User
**Requirements:** FR-PROF-01, FR-PROF-02

Creates or replaces the signed-in user's career profile for use by downstream AI features.

get.description:
**Access:** Public

Returns the current liveness status and response timestamp.
